records.body:

records.subject: Welcome aboard, Vantage Media
records.body:
Hi Ahmed,

Welcome! Wrenfield works best once there's a real project in it, so that's the one thing I'd suggest doing first. Inviting your team comes next -- tasks are a lot more useful once more than one person is on them.

Reply any time.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Vantage Media* just joined on the pro plan!

decisions.rationale: Six days in with no project, no invite, no milestone, and zero replies to two outreach emails (email:ec880b33, email:54903034) and no tickets — no signal of engagement. Pro plan gives slight positive, but silent accounts rarely self-activate in the remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: A first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Ahmed,

Following up on my last note. If setup hasn't started yet, the easiest first step is creating a first project — projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and once it's there, inviting your team is quick.

Would a short call this week help? I can walk through getting that first project set up with you and answer anything else.

Best,
Chidi
